function.name: analyze_ui_screenshot
function.description: Analyze the current UI screenshot and return clickable controls, recognized text, semantic roles and exact screenshot coordinates. The tool host supplies the current screenshot to the executor; do not generate or pass image bytes from the model. Use this before clicking or navigating a graphical application.

include.description: Result groups to return. Use controls for clickable targets, elements for all fused elements, texts for OCR, metadata for runtime/timing details, or annotated_image for a Base64-rendered PNG. Default: controls,texts,metadata.

annotate.description: Include a Base64 annotated PNG in the JSON result.
